title: Deeper/broader peer transfer-loss and source-authored SAB readiness review
mode: primary-source research and local test-inventory review
scope: Screen newly visible ACadRust transfer-loss and bounded-reader reports against libdxfrw's direction/version scope
Cross-check ACadRust legacy-codepage and orphan-owner reports against existing local PAR-05 and object-graph evidence
Map peer TABLE/TABLESTYLE, color-name, XDATA, custom-class and record-boundary reports to existing local owners
Evaluate a source-authored SAB writer route for the current AC1032 carrier handoff
Update plan readiness without installing dependencies, adding fixtures, or blocking local implementation

method.kind: Read-only review of public project issues/API docs/crate release history and local source/test inventory
method.limitations: ACadRust issues are reporter evidence with private/unavailable drawings. ACadRust API docs and crate release pages are mutable or versioned separately; no exact package was built. The current environment lacks the documented SAB-generator toolchains/packages, so no payload was generated.

sources.revision: issue body and activity reviewed 2026-10-17; reproducer names 0.6.3 and main ea68744
sources.observed: The report says DXF-to-DWG output drops raw-only custom-class entities/objects, entity group-430 color-book names, and table/block-record XDATA. It references a maintainer commit and request to retest; this is not release qualification or a libdxfrw defect.
The report describes AC1024+ TABLE merged ranges and TABLESTYLE title/header suppression represented in separate fields on DWG and DXF routes, with conversion loss in the cited peer revision.

sources.revision: issue body and activity reviewed 2026-10-17; report names 0.6.4 and private corpus
sources.observed: The report says 70 of 351 private AC1032 files failed after stricter record bounds, mostly on AcDbMLeaderObjectContextData. A maintainer commit was offered for retest, but the issue page does not provide shareable drawings or an independent post-fix result.

sources.revision: issue body and proposed fix activity reviewed 2026-10-17; report names 0.6.3/main ea68744
sources.observed: The report provides literal mismatches for several OEM pages, Mac Roman, and Johab and references proposed commit 9f3a8b5 with a retest request. It is already mapped to local PAR-05; the proposed peer fix is not an independent release result.

sources.revision: issue body and proposed fix activity reviewed 2026-10-17; report names 0.6.3 and a private 351-file corpus
sources.observed: The report says orphan entities with missing owner BLOCK_RECORD handles were moved to model space, creating phantom dimension geometry. Proposed commit b62555f was offered for retest; no private DWG corpus is available for independent reproduction. Existing local owner-graph policy already covers the failure class.

The page documents a build_box helper with a complete box topology (6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices). It is candidate source-authored geometry construction, not a qualified SAB payload or semantic witness.
The SAB module documents SabWriter converting SatDocument to SAB. A build must pin the exact crate/source version and confirm the API at that version before use.

The published package history lists 0.6.4 dated 2026-10-11; docs.rs pages may expose different rendered versions, so package, source tag/commit, and API documentation must be reconciled before a reproducible authoring run.

sources.revision: working tree over baseline de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9 reviewed 2026-10-17
sources.observed: Existing generated owners cover TABLE/TABLESTYLE model fields and DXF output, color-name DXF read/write, XDATA ownership/output, and bounded record/parser behavior. This inventory does not prove every DWG-origin TABLE field is projected through all stages. libdxfrw does not implement DWG writing, so peer DXF-to-DWG omissions are outside direct writer scope.

assessment.peerIssueUse: Transfer/safety/codepage/owner test-shape evidence only; no issue is treated as a local reproduction or normative format rule.
assessment.acisAuthoringRoute: ACadRust build_box plus SabWriter is a candidate scratch-only source-authoring path. It is the same codec lineage already in the peer ledger, not an independent parser or semantic witness. Independently authored expected bounds/volume and exact carrier owner/key association remain mandatory.
assessment.environmentReadiness: The route cannot run in this checkout because cargo/rustc and ezdxf are absent. Do not install tooling during fast slices; use the route only at the composed checkpoint if its pinned toolchain is available, otherwise record NOT_AVAILABLE and continue local implementation.
assessment.boundedRecovery: Do not remove record bounds or silently drop records to imitate peer recovery. Recovery requires proven record extent, explicit incomplete disposition, and safe continuation; otherwise fail the read.

implementationReadyChecks: Continue the next ready local implementation slice; SAB author availability is not a blocker.
At the composed checkpoint, pin an immutable ACadRust source/package and confirm build_box/SabWriter APIs before authoring any scratch SAB.
Use source-authored asymmetric dimensions and an independent analytic manifest; verify all expected bodies, entity-to-AcDs association, data index/key, payload digest, and strict readback separately.
Keep kernel/native outcomes distinct from carrier retention; do not promote external-only J items from peer issue reports or same-lineage generated data.
